title: A rough guide for going back to the Moon
summary: IBM and NASA collaborated to develop a foundation model specifically for lunar exploration, using AI/ML technology to analyze lunar data and support the Artemis program's goal of returning humans to the Moon.
problem_solved: Enables efficient analysis of vast amounts of lunar data to accelerate Moon exploration research and mission planning.
why_valuable: Foundation models trained on lunar data can significantly reduce research time and provide AI-powered insights for scientists working on the Artemis missions.
